```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    permissions:
      issues: write
      contents: read
    env:
      ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
      ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude triage
        id: claude
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Escape title and body for safe inclusion in the prompt
          ESCAPED_TITLE=$(printf '%s' "$ISSUE_TITLE" | jq -Rsa .)
          ESCAPED_BODY=$(printf '%s' "$ISSUE_BODY" | jq -Rsa .)
          # Strip the surrounding quotes added by jq
          ESCAPED_TITLE=${ESCAPED_TITLE:1:-1}
          ESCAPED_BODY=${ESCAPED_BODY:1:-1}

          PROMPT=$(cat <<EOF
          You are an issue triage assistant for the OB1 repository. The repository is a TypeScript project. The issue has been opened with the following title and body:
          Title: $ESCAPED_TITLE
          Body: $ESCAPED_BODY
          Please:
          1. Classify the issue into one of the following categories: bug, recipe idea, schema idea, feature request, documentation, duplicate, or other.
          2. Check if the issue is a duplicate of an existing open issue. If so, provide the duplicate issue number.
          3. Assess if the issue scope fits the repository. If it does not, suggest a better place or indicate that it is out of scope.
          4. Suggest labels to apply from the following list: bug, enhancement, documentation, duplicate, question, help wanted, good first issue, recipe, schema, feature, out-of-scope.
          5. Generate a welcoming comment that thanks the contributor, summarizes the classification, and includes any duplicate notice or scope advice.
          Output in JSON format with keys: category, duplicate_issue_number (or null), scope_fit (true/false), suggested_labels (array), welcome_comment (string).
          EOF
          )

          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages" \
            -H "x-api-key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}" \
            -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
            -H "content-type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "model": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
              "max_tokens": 500,
              "temperature": 0,
              "messages": [
                {"role": "user", "content": "'"${PROMPT}"'"}
              ]
            }')

          OUTPUT=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.content[0].text')
          echo "output=$OUTPUT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Parse Claude output
        id: parse
        run: |
          echo "Claude output: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.output }}"
          echo "category=${{ fromJSON(steps.claude.outputs.output).category }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "duplicate=${{ fromJSON(steps.claude.outputs.output).duplicate_issue_number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "scope_fit=${{ fromJSON(steps.claude.outputs.output).scope_fit }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "labels=${{ toJSON(fromJSON(steps.claude.outputs.output).suggested_labels) }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "comment=${{ fromJSON(steps.claude.outputs.output).welcome_comment }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Add suggested labels
        if: steps.parse.outputs.labels != '[]'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const labels = JSON.parse(process.env.LABELS);
            const issue_number = ${{ github.event.issue.number }};
            await github.issues.addLabels({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number,
              labels
            });
        env:
          LABELS: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.labels }}

      - name: Add duplicate label and comment
        if: steps.parse.outputs.duplicate != 'null'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const issue_number = ${{ github.event.issue.number }};
            const duplicate_issue = ${{ steps.parse.outputs.duplicate }};
            await github.issues.addLabels({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number,
              labels: ['duplicate']
            });
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number,
              body: `This issue appears to be a duplicate of #${duplicate_issue}.`
            });

      - name: Post welcoming comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const issue_number = ${{ github.event.issue.number }};
            const comment = process.env.COMMENT;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number,
              body: comment
            });
        env:
          COMMENT: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.comment }}
```
